math.title: Adding Same-Denominator Fractions
math.content: When fractions share the same bottom number (denominator), keep that number the same and just add the top numbers (numerators)!

math.title: Finding Rules in Sequences
math.content: Look at the change between numbers. Are they increasing by adding/multiplying, or decreasing by subtracting?

math.title: Shapes & Properties
math.content: 2D shapes have flat sides and corners. 3D shapes (like spheres, cubes, and cylinders) have volume in real space!

science.title: How Plants Produce Energy
science.content: Plants absorb Carbon Dioxide, Water, and Sunlight in their chloroplasts to create Glucose sugar and Oxygen!

science.title: Solids, Liquids, and Gases
science.content: Solids keep a fixed shape, liquids flow to fit their container, and gases expand freely into available space.

science.title: Gravity vs Friction
science.content: Gravity pulls objects down toward Earth's center, while friction resists sliding movement between surfaces.

english.title: Nouns, Verbs, Adjectives & Adverbs
english.content: Nouns name things, verbs show actions, adjectives describe nouns, and adverbs describe how actions happen.

english.title: Synonyms & Antonyms
english.content: Synonyms are words with similar meanings (giant / huge), while antonyms have opposite meanings (bravery / cowardice).

english.title: Deep Narrative Synthesis
english.content: Read passages carefully for subtle clues and character motives, rather than relying on superficial impressions!

questions.passage: For three weeks, the quiet harbor town prepared for the annual winter storm. Merchants boarded up windows, and sailors doubled the ropes binding their ships to the wooden piers. Old Captain Vance stood by the lighthouse, holding a bronze compass that hadn't spun toward magnetic north in forty years. He noticed the seagulls flying inland—a behavior that only occurred when atmospheric pressure dropped drastically within an hour. While the younger sailors laughed, believing the calm morning sun meant safety, Vance quietly dragged his small fishing boat entirely out of the water and locked it inside the stone boathouse.
questions.question_text: Why did Captain Vance pull his boat completely out of the water while others ignored the threat?
options: His broken bronze compass signaled an immediate storm direction.
He observed animal behavior shifts indicating a sharp drop in atmospheric pressure.
The young sailors ordered him to secure his boat in the stone boathouse.
questions.correct_answer: He observed animal behavior shifts indicating a sharp drop in atmospheric pressure.
questions.hint: Consider what the seagulls flying inland signified to Vance despite the sunny weather.
